result.quote: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he built towers in the desert and dug many cisterns.
result.reason: The verse connects building the towers with Uzziah’s having much livestock, not with his love of farming. His being “a lover of the soil” instead explains why he employed farmers and vinedressers. Also, the window calls them “towers,” not specifically “watch towers,” so that unsupported modifier should be removed.
